name: greenpulse
description: Public Park Ecosystem Health Monitoring System & Urban Biodiversity Mapping Portal — a two-part project: backend/ (Express API) and frontend/ (Next.js).

scripts.//: This root package.json only delegates to the two real projects. Run these from the repository root.
scripts.setup: npm run setup:backend && npm run setup:frontend
scripts.//check: Type-check the frontend and run the backend test suite
scripts.//note: There is no combined 'start' script on purpose — each server needs its own terminal so you can read its logs and stop it independently.
scripts.start:
node -e "console.log('
GreenPulse needs TWO terminals.

  Terminal 1:  npm run backend:dev   -> http://localhost:5000/api
  Terminal 2:  npm run frontend:dev  -> http://localhost:3000

First time only:  npm run setup  (then copy the .env.example files)
')"
